items._comment: PLACEHOLDER TIERS. `amount` stays null until the director sets the real price points -- a sponsorship level is a PROMISE, not an estimate, so the no-invented-figures rule in CLAUDE.md applies here too. A tier with amount:null renders 'Amount being confirmed' and sends the sponsor to the form instead of quoting a price. Benefits must be CONCRETE: nobody writes a cheque for 'recognition'. Name the deliverable -- logo on game jerseys, banner at the tournament, a booth at back-to-school, a named scholarship.
